title: English longbowmen win the Battle of Crecy
summary: An English army under Edward III, dismounted and backed by massed longbows, destroyed a larger French army in northern France. Many French nobles died in repeated cavalry charges.
reason: Edward III claimed the French throne and was raiding through Normandy when Philip VI caught up with him.
significance: It was a turning point in the Hundred Years' War and in the decline of the mounted knight.
